default_binding_header_decision.reason: This family should default to existing Rust PCI/miscdevice/uaccess/page/mm surfaces instead of exposing legacy C headers through bindgen.

default_external_header_decision.reason: External/private source headers need an explicit landing, omission, or Rust-side replacement decision before driver codegen.

linux/pci.h.reason: The Rust driver should use `kernel::pci` instead of bindgen-visible PCI structures and callbacks.

linux/miscdevice.h.reason: The Rust driver should use `kernel::miscdevice` rather than registering `struct miscdevice` directly.

linux/fs.h.reason: File operations should stay behind `kernel::miscdevice` abstractions.

linux/uaccess.h.reason: User copy logic should route through `kernel::uaccess` instead of raw copy helpers.

linux/mm.h.reason: PFN/VMA mapping should route through `kernel::mm::virt::VmaNew` instead of exposing raw `linux/mm.h` helpers to the driver surface.

linux/io.h.reason: BAR/shared-memory mapping should route through a dedicated PCI abstraction instead of exposing raw driver-visible mappings.

pci.reason: The driver depends on PCI probe/remove wiring and resource ownership.
required_surface: A typed `pci::Driver` trait that owns probe/remove registration.
A safe PCI device surface for enabling the device and tying driver state lifetime to the bound device.

miscdevice.reason: The driver exposes a miscdevice user API and needs safe file operation registration.
required_surface: An owned miscdevice registration that deregisters on drop.
A typed open/release/ioctl/mmap callback surface that does not require raw `file_operations` in driver code.

uaccess.reason: The driver exchanges ioctl payloads with userspace and needs a typed user-copy surface.
required_surface: Typed user pointer/slice access for request decoding and reply writes.

page.reason: Some miscdevice-backed drivers keep page-backed request or ping buffers whose allocation, physical address exposure, and teardown must stay owned by Rust state.
required_surface: An owned page allocation surface that frees on drop.
A safe way to export the page physical address and do bounded page-local IO for request buffers.

vma_pfn_map.reason: The driver exports device memory through `mmap`, which needs explicit VMA/PFN mapping proof obligations.
required_surface: A dedicated Rust wrapper for PFN remapping into `VmaNew` that encodes the required VMA flag preconditions.

shared_bar_map.reason: The driver keeps mapped BAR/shared-memory ranges whose lifetime must stay bound to the PCI device and module teardown.
required_surface: A safe owner for BAR/shared memory mappings so driver code never stores raw mapped pointers.

body_plan: Keep this callback outside the first Rust loop until the corresponding abstraction exists and the artifacts explicitly allow it.
